CAUTION 6.1             . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 247
               Make sure that the DLG drive PCB cage will not collide with the inner arm cover when the BLD
                           is rotated. If you ignore this caution, it can cause damage to the equipment.

WARNING 6.6           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 249
               Do not look into the UV light without protective glasses when the Agility™ MLC covers or
                    crosswires screen are removed. If you ignore this warning, you can cause serious injury.

WARNING 6.7           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 249
               Do not do work on the inner parts of the BLD when the power is on. The power can cause the
                    inner parts to move. If you ignore this warning, you can cause fatal injury.

WARNING 6.8           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 251
               Do not look into the ultraviolet light without protective glasses when the Agility™ BLD covers
                   or crosswires screen are removed. If you ignore this warning, it can cause serious injury to
                  your eyes.

WARNING 6.9           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 251
               Do not touch the LED field light projector and the heatsink immediately after operation.
                   During operation, they become hot. If you ignore this warning, it can cause serious injury.

WARNING 6.10         . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 253
               Do not do work on the Agility™ beam limiting device unless the gantry is at 0° or 180°. Gravity
                  can cause the leaves, diaphragms and DLGs to move. If you ignore this warning, it can cause
                       fatal injury.
